reviewText.writes: Approve and create writes the event's name and details, the counts, the times, the date when ticked, the package, the kitchen plan, the bar, the entertainment, the setup plan, the POS box, the timeline's steps, the team you ticked and the deposit — everything above, in one go. Nothing opens after it; a field the BEO already holds keeps its value unless you take the chat's.
reviewText.replaces: This BEO already has its package, kitchen plan: approving replaces what the review fills.
